reason: A browser-side chat UI plugin that lets users stage selected conversation text as attributed quote tabs and include those quotes in the next submitted message.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框上方暂存选中的对话内容，并在发送问题时将其作为带发言者标注的引用加入消息。
summaries.en: A browser-side chat UI plugin that stages selected conversation text as attributed quotes and adds them to the next message when submitted.

capabilities: Reads user-selected text from chat messages
Adds removable quote tabs above the chat composer
Merges staged quotes into the outgoing user draft on submission
